approval_gate: The dispatch line `observation = TOOLS[tool_name](**tool_args)`: before it, check whether tool_name is in a WRITE set and, if so, ask a human (input() today, an approval queue in production) and return {'error': 'not approved'} as the observation when they say no.
step_cap: Nothing else stops the loop: a model that keeps calling tools, or never replies with 'final', would run and bill forever. MAX_STEPS turns that into a loud, cheap failure.
